entries.name: Mason Tipton
entries.summary: Tipton (leg) is expected to begin the 2026 regular season on the reserve/PUP list, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Tip Reiman
entries.summary: Reiman (ankle) will not be back for the start of the regular season, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Charbonnet (knee) remains on the active/PUP list as the Seahawks' second preseason contest (Sunday, Aug. 23 versus the Titans) approaches.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Pierce (ankle) is working out prior to Saturday's preseason game against the Lions but will not play, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Ashton Jeanty
entries.summary: Jeanty's ankle injury is being monitored in advance of Week 1, but per head coach Klint Kubiak, the Raiders are "counting on him" to be available, Levi Edwards of the Raiders' official website reports.

entries.name: Ben Sims
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ben Sinnott
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury and is unlikely to play in Friday's preseason finale versus the Ravens, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Brandon Smith
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (groin) took part in agility drills on the side at Monday's practice, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (undisclosed) was on the field for Sunday's training camp practice, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan (knee) did not participate at Monday's training camp practice, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
entries.summary: Thomas (shoulder) was present on the field for Wednesday's joint practice with the Buccaneers while sporting a no-contact jersey, John Shipley of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (ribs) continued to be a limited participant at Monday's practice, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (calf) continued to work on a side field at Saturday's practice, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Christian McCaffrey
entries.summary: McCaffrey (undisclosed) said Sunday that he always planned to take a break during training camp and then "ramp back up," Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chuba Hubbard
entries.summary: Hubbard (hamstring) remains on track for Week 1, according to Steve Reed of the Associated Press.

entries.name: Coleman Owen
entries.summary: Owen has entered the league's concussion protocol, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Davis Allen
entries.summary: Allen (quadriceps) was a limited participant in Monday's training camp practice, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (shoulder) won't suit up for Thursday's preseason contest at Las Vegas, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Devin Neal
entries.summary: Neal sustained a hamstring injury during the Saints' 34-0 preseason loss to the Rams on Saturday, Matthew Paras of The New Orleans Times-Picayune reports.

entries.name: DK Metcalf
entries.summary: Metcalf (undisclosed) has agreed to a restructured contract with the Steelers, Field Yates of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (undisclosed) didn't practice Monday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: Stowers (hamstring) may not be active on gamedays even if he returns to health before the start of the regular season, according to Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.

entries.name: Emanuel Wilson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Egbuka (toe), per head coach Todd Bowles, will "hopefully" be ready for Week 1, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: George Kittle
entries.summary: Kittle (Achilles) is expected to practice this week as he continues his push to play in the 49ers' season opener against the Rams in Australia, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Grant Calcaterra
entries.summary: Calcatarra (back) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

entries.name: Ihmir Smith-Marsette
entries.summary: Smith-Marsette (ankle) will not return to Friday night's preseason finale against the Packers, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Isaiah Davis
entries.summary: Davis (knee) worked out on a side field with a trainer during Tuesday's practice, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Pacheco's knee injury, per head coach Dan Campbell, is not a concern, but he is now dealing with a back injury, Dave Birkett of the Detroit Free Press reports.

entries.name: J.J. McCarthy
entries.summary: McCarthy (ankle) won't suit up for Friday's preseason game at Denver, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Ja'Marr Chase
entries.summary: Chase (knee) is not participating in Wednesday's practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jacob Cowing
entries.summary: Cowing (groin) did not participate at the 49ers' training camp practice Tuesday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
entries.summary: Croskey-Merritt (lower body) won't suit up for Friday's preseason game at Baltimore.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Head coach Liam Coen said after Friday's 34-17 preseason loss to the Panthers that Meyers jammed his right hand during Wednesday's joint practice with Carolina, Juston Lewis of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said Saturday that he expects McMillan (knee) to be available for the Buccaneers' Week 1 clash against the Bengals on Sunday, Sept. 13, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that it's "too early to tell" if Conner (foot) will be ready for Week 1 against the Chargers, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

entries.name: Jawhar Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan (hip) is likely to resume practicing next week, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Love (ankle) did not play in Friday's preseason loss to the Packers, but per Cardinals team reporter Zach Gershman, he was able to work out prior to the game.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols (quadriceps) will not play in Saturday's preseason game against Detroit.

entries.name: Joe Royer
entries.summary: Royer (personal) did not play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Patriots.

entries.name: Josh Downs
entries.summary: Downs is not practicing Wednesday due to a calf injury, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs (groin), who was charged Thursday with two misdemeanors stemming from his May arrest, is scheduled for an initial court appearance Nov. 17, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Kalel Mullings
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Keaton Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (undisclosed) did not play in Thursday's 20-18 preseason loss to the Rams.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: Walker is experiencing swelling around his ankle but is expected to "be fine," Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Kenyon Sadiq
entries.summary: Jets offensive coordinator Frank Reich said Tuesday that Sadiq (hernia) will be worked in slowly at the start of the regular season, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Keon Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (right foot/toe) isn't in uniform for Thursday's preseason game against the Steelers, but he wasn't wearing a walking boot, Alex Brasky of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Khalil Shakir
entries.summary: Shakir (undisclosed) isn't in uniform for Thursday's preseason contest against the Steelers, Alex Brasky of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Kurtis Rourke
entries.summary: Coach Kyle Shanahan said Tuesday that Rourke (ribs) has a chance to return to the field next week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (knee) is considered week-to-week, Adam Jahns of AllCHGO.com reports.

entries.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Luther Burden III
entries.summary: Burden (groin) did not suit up for Saturday's preseason victory over the Titans but did run routes pregame, according to Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune.

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Nabers (knee) isn't suited up for Friday's preseason game versus the Jets, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Sean Payton told reporters that Mims bruised his foot during the Broncos' 34-6 preseason win over the Vikings on Friday, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Penix (knee) won't play in Friday's preseason game in Miami, but he believes he'll be available for a Week 1 road matchup with the Steelers on Sunday, Sept. 13, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (right ankle) was in pads and going through stretching during Monday's practice, Alan Saunders of Steelers Now reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans' groin injury is considered minor, and he plans to be ready for the 49ers' Week 1 regular-season opener against the Rams on Thursday, Sept. 10, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Mitchell Trubisky
entries.summary: Trubisky (biceps) did not participate in Wednesday's practice, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

entries.name: Noah Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (ankle) is regarded as day-to-day as of Friday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Ollie Gordon II
entries.summary: Gordon injured his ribs during the Dolphins' 26-3 preseason loss to the Giants on Saturday, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Oscar Delp
entries.summary: Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at training camp with the Saints, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Patrick Mahomes
entries.summary: Mahomes (knee) is on track to start Week 1 against the Broncos, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (groin) isn't practicing Monday, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Rachaad White
entries.summary: White (hamstring) isn't suited up for Friday's preseason game in Baltimore.

entries.name: Sam LaPorta
entries.summary: LaPorta (hip) returned to practice Tuesday, Richard Silva of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (soreness) was working off to the side at Tuesday's practice, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson missed Wednesday's practice due to a shoulder injury, Evan Barnes of Newsday reports.

entries.name: Tory Horton
entries.summary: Horton (undisclosed) is not dealing with a long-term injury, Corbin K. Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: Harris (undisclosed) did not play in the Chargers' 20-18 preseason loss to the Rams on Thursday.

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson (ankle) is expected to be available for New England's Week 1 matchup with the Seahawks, Christopher Price of The Boston Globe reports.

entries.name: Trevor Etienne
entries.summary: Etienne (ankle) is being evaluated to diagnose the extent of his injury, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Tucker Kraft
entries.summary: Kraft (knee) is expected to be "full go" for the Packers' Week 1 regular-season opener against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ty Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (lower leg) didn't practice Tuesday, but head coach Joe Brady said that the running back has resumed sprinting, Jay Skurski of The Buffalo News reports.

entries.name: Tyler Warren
entries.summary: Warren (groin) may not practice this week as the team prepares to have him available for the season opener, Jake Arthur of Roundtable Sports  reports.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: Tracy (neck) is dealing with a stinger, but it is not believed to be a major injury, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
entries.summary: Robinson is not believed to have sustained a concussion during Thursday's joint practice with the Bears, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Will Howard
entries.summary: Howard (head) is being evaluated for a potential concussion after Thursday's preseason finale against the Bills, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

entries.name: Will Kacmarek
entries.summary: Kacmarek (undisclosed) is considered week-to-week as of Saturday, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory did not play in the Colts' 34-6 preseason loss to the Falcons on Saturday due to a thumb injury, Joel A. Erickson of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Legette (ankle) will remain in a walking boot on his foot until Thursday, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers isn't practicing Wednesday for the second consecutive day while he tends to an apparent undisclosed injury, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.

entries.name: Calvin Austin III
entries.summary: The Giants placed Austin (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Patricia Traina of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Cole Burgess
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Cole Turner
entries.summary: Turner (undisclosed) reverted to the Dolphins' injured-reserve list Thursday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Jake Bobo
entries.summary: The Seahawks placed Bobo (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jameson Geers
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Jaren Kanak
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Jayden Higgins
entries.summary: The Texans placed Higgins (knee) on injured reserve Friday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jeff Caldwell
entries.summary: Caldwell (knee) reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list Tuesday, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.

entries.name: Matthew Caldwell
entries.summary: The Rams placed Caldwell (undisclosed) on injured reserve Saturday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Moliki Matavao
entries.summary: The Saints placed Matavao (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Myles Montgomery
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Nikola Kalinic
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Trey Benson
entries.summary: Benson (knee) reverted to the Cardinals' injured reserve list Tuesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Trey Sermon
entries.summary: The Falcons placed Sermon (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Ty Chandler
entries.summary: The Saints placed Chandler (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Xavier Weaver
entries.summary: Weaver (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve by the Cardinals on Monday.

entries.name: Jeshaun Jones
entries.summary: The NFL suspended Jones three games Tuesday for violating the league's substance-abuse policy, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
